contract_fields._comment: Every capability carries a `contract` with all six keys, non-empty. Enforced by scripts/capability-audit.py --check. A capability may not be promoted above PARTIAL unless every contract field is a concrete claim (not 'unknown'/'TBD'). `live_verification` is honest about provider access: 'BLOCKED - ...' when no live DB/deploy check was run this session. Browser runtime is verified automatically by scripts/verify-runtime.js (capability-evidence.yml + ci-local.sh --all).
contract_fields.entrypoint: the shipped file(s) a user or gate actually reaches this capability through
contract_fields.data_contract: where state lives: named Supabase table(s)/RPC(s) and key columns, or 'device-local', or 'none (static/client-only)'
contract_fields.authorization: the boundary that decides who may read/write: RLS policy name + grant, is_platform_owner() gate, approval guard, or 'n/a (no server data)'
contract_fields.failure_path: how a failed operation surfaces to the user or gate; names the check (.error handling) or records the gap
contract_fields.static_evidence: the automated/static check that proves the above without a live system: a script, CI step, or test
contract_fields.live_verification: result of a real production DB/deploy check, with date - or 'BLOCKED - <reason>' when none was possible
